old_title: Billy Slater to step down as Maroons' head coach
new_title: Billy Slater to step down as Maroons' head coach
old_text:
Billy Slater steps down as head coach of Queensland Maroons
In short:
Queensland Maroons head coach Billy Slater has announced he will step down from the role.
Slater took on the head coach role in 2021 and led the Maroons to three victories in the State of Origin series against NSW.
What's next?
The Queensland Rugby League says it will begin a process to appoint the next head coach soon.

Queensland Maroons head coach Billy Slater has announced he will step down from the role.
Slater was appointed head coach in 2021 and guided the Maroons to three victories out of five in the State of Origin series against NSW.
What's next?
The Queensland Rugby League says it will begin a process to appoint the next head coach soon.
